in_sanskrit.name: Sharwik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious, Brave
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharwik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharwik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', which means 'Goddess of Wealth, Fortune and Prosperity'. The suffix '-ik' denotes 'one who possesses'. So Sharwik can be translated to 'One who possesses the Goddess of Wealth and Fortune'.
